prompt: Before we see how the dataset was made: the rubric criteria for each task were first drafted by an AI model (Claude Opus 4.6). What do you expect happened next?
options: The criteria were discarded and replaced by automatically generated unit tests
The drafted criteria were used as-is, since the judge only needs consistency
Human reviewers validated and refined the drafted criteria

private.resolution: The AI drafted candidates, but reviewers were tasked with validating and refining them. The next section explains the wider pipeline of human involvement.
